baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural وُجُوهٌ and predicate بَاسِرَةٌ join an outward human front to a marked facial condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The face is the surface presented to an observer, while the predicate supplies contraction, frowning, anxiety, and dread. The clause therefore makes inward aversion publicly legible.

activation_trace.role: The face/front is the outward surface meeting an observer, so it locates the condition on the publicly visible human front.
Grimacing and severe displeasure supply the visible contraction and its affective load of anxiety or dread.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely labels a group by a facial state.
changed_reading.after: Each person's public front involuntarily displays severe dread; the face is the disclosure surface of the condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَاسِرَةٌ modifies the visible وُجُوهٌ and can draw on the root's branch of standing still with little movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The facial surface does not only frown; it becomes motion-poor and fixed. Affect is rendered kinetically as an arrested front.

activation_trace.role: The outward face/front supplies the visible plane on which arrested motion can be read.
Stillness and reduced movement recast the predicate as a freeze or stoppage rather than emotion alone.

changed_reading.before: The faces show an unpleasant emotion.
changed_reading.after: The faces are visibly arrested, with dread appearing as loss of movement and responsiveness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وُجُوهٌ can stand for persons, while بَاسِرَةٌ has a branch for freshness, unripeness, or action before its proper time.
baseline_models.mechanism: The whole person is compressed into the face, and that person appears raw, premature, or not brought to proper maturity for the encountered day.

activation_trace.role: Face as self or person permits the material condition of the face to characterize the whole subject.
Unripeness and acts performed before their due time supply a temporal-material state of being unready.

changed_reading.before: The predicate names a mature facial expression of distress.
changed_reading.after: The persons appear exposed in a raw, before-its-time condition, as though their formation or timing has failed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وُجُوهٌ can carry orientation or facing, and بَاسِرَةٌ has a force-and-compulsion branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be heard as a condition in which subjects no longer choose how or where they face. Their directional agency is placed under force, and the visible face bears that coercion.

activation_trace.role: Orientation, destination, and directed movement turn the face into an index of directional agency.
Overpowering and compulsion supply the loss of voluntary control over that facing.

changed_reading.after: The faces mark subjects whose orientation has been forcibly taken over.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's anatomical arc gathers separated bones, restores even extremities, recalls creation and completed form, and closes with life returned after death. Against that arc, the focus faces are identifying fronts of fully reconstituted persons, not detached masks or a vague crowd.

activation_trace.role: Face standing for self lets the visible front carry the identity of the reconstituted person.
The grimace supplies the newly embodied person's involuntary visible response.
Joining dispersed parts into one whole supplies the reconstruction operation.
The hard bone gives the reconstruction a concrete bodily substrate.
Integrity and completion of the thing make reconstruction exact rather than approximate.
The bodily extremities extend restored identity to fine anatomical detail.
Completed and proportionate form links original embodiment to its later restoration.
Living animate existence supplies the state restored to the reconstructed subject.
Loss of force and life supplies the condition reversed by that restoration.

structural_cues: The opening challenge in 75:3-4 and closing challenge in 75:37-40 bracket the face scene with bodily reconstruction.
The plural faces in 75:24 occur after the claim that even the smallest extremities can be restored.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disassembly, exact bodily formation, and revival; I infer that 'faces' compress fully reconstituted identities into their identifying fronts. Alternatively, the body passages may only establish resurrection while face remains ordinary metonymy.

changed_reading.before: The faces are a generic crowd-image.
changed_reading.after: They are the exposed fronts of specifically rebuilt persons, whose identities and reactions have been restored down to bodily detail.

context_deltas.mechanism: A subject who wants to rupture the path ahead, seeks an escape, finds no refuge, and turns away is finally driven toward the Lord. The baseline coercive orientation becomes a full reversal of agency: self-directed forward motion is replaced by compulsory conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Orientation and destination make the face a gauge of who controls direction.
Compulsion supplies the imposed force that takes over the subject's orientation.
Wide rupture and bursting project an attempt to open an unrestricted course forward.
The front or ahead supplies the temporal-spatial corridor the subject wants to control.
Flight and escape show attempted self-directed motion once the day arrives.
The refuge branch supplies the destination explicitly denied to flight.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the terminal authority toward whom motion is redirected.
Driving and herding provide the causal force of compulsory conveyance.
Turning away supplies the earlier contrary orientation that the final drive reverses.

structural_cues: The motion arc runs from أَمَامَهُ in 75:5 and أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ in 75:10 through لَا وَزَرَ in 75:11 to إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ... ٱلْمَسَاقُ in 75:30.
The later وَتَوَلَّىٰ names a prior turning away after the compulsory destination has been stated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted forward rupture, flight, denied refuge, contrary turning, sovereignty, and driving; I infer an arrow from failed self-direction to imposed Lordward direction. Alternatively, these may be separate motion images and the focus may mark fear without encoding agency transfer.

changed_reading.before: The faces show distress at an unspecified event.
changed_reading.after: Their distress is the visible resistance of subjects whose power to choose a direction has ended and whose course is now imposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person is inwardly perceptive against the self even while casting excuses, whose inventory also permits a curtain image. The grimacing face becomes involuntary evidence: inner recognition reaches the outward surface and cannot be screened by offered coverings.

activation_trace.role: Face as person or self joins the visible witness to the subject it exposes.
The anxious grimace is the involuntary outward mark that the excuses fail to suppress.
The thing's own self fixes the witness and the accused in one subject.
Inner insight supplies self-recognition prior to any outward defense.
Casting or throwing makes the defenses active projections rather than ignorance.
Excuse and exculpation supply the explicit defensive content.
Curtains supply a spatial image for defenses that try to cover what the face reveals.

structural_cues: The sequence 75:13-15 moves from being informed, to self-sight, to defenses introduced as ineffective even if cast.
The adversive بَلْ and concessive وَلَوْ keep self-knowledge stronger than the offered excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self, inward sight, casting, excuses, and a curtain branch; I infer that the face externalizes knowledge that verbal coverings cannot hide. Alternatively, the curtain is only a lexical side branch and the face may simply show fear of the announced result.

changed_reading.after: The grimace functions as uncurtained testimony by the self against itself, exposing what excuses attempt to cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: An ordered sequence forbids haste, places gathering and recitation before following and explanation, and is followed by loving the immediate while leaving the later. This activates the focus predicate's before-ripeness branch: the face is the material result of a preference that repeatedly takes things before their proper term.

activation_trace.role: Face as person allows temporal unripeness to characterize the whole chooser.
Unripe matter and action before its due time provide the changed reading's central temporal-material image.
Lateness after the first term supplies the deferred horizon that is abandoned.
Putting something forth before its proper maturation directly activates the focus's premature branch.
Speed and preemption characterize the immediate object of preference.
Following in sequence supplies the proper ordered alternative to premature action.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the later completion of the ordered process.
Love fixed in the heart makes haste a sustained preference rather than a momentary mistake.
Deliberate leaving supplies the rejection of the later term needed for the timing contrast.

structural_cues: 75:16-19 is explicitly sequenced: no haste, then gathering, recitation, following, and explanation.
75:20-21 immediately generalizes the contrast as attachment to the immediate and abandonment of the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies premature placement, ordered following and disclosure, love of the immediate, and abandonment of the later; I infer that this timing preference ripens into the raw condition of the focus face. Alternatively, the revelation instruction and collective preference may remain separate registers, and the predicate may be purely affective.

changed_reading.before: The unripeness branch is an isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The face appears morally and temporally unripe, displaying the end state of repeatedly preferring what comes too soon over what comes later.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier gaze is fixed in shock, while the immediately paired face class is radiant and directs sight toward its Lord. The focus face is therefore relational, not merely colored by mood: its contracted or arrested front stands opposite a face capable of luminous, intentional orientation.

activation_trace.role: Direction and facing make the focus face a relational orientation rather than a flat appearance.
Stillness supplies the possibility that the contrasting face has an arrested orientation or gaze.
A fixed, staring eye establishes visual arrest as an earlier bodily response to the day.
Sovereignty identifies the relational pole toward which the contrasted faces direct themselves.
The repeated outward face creates the explicit counterpart to the focus face.
Fresh beauty and radiance supply the positive surface state against which contraction is read.
Directed sight or insight supplies active orientation for the radiant counterpart.

structural_cues: 75:22 and 75:24 repeat the same indefinite plural noun, day-marker, and feminine singular predicate frame.
75:23 is inserted between the paired descriptions and gives the first face class an explicit إِلَىٰ direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed sight, a matched pair of face clauses, radiance, and directed Lordward looking; I infer that the contrast includes visual and directional capacity. Alternatively, looking may characterize only the first class without implying that the focus faces cannot orient or see.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply opposes a happy facial expression with a sad one.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts two relational fronts: one luminous and actively directed, the other contracted and potentially arrested in its capacity to face.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah makes the face anticipate an action to be done to it and names a calamity through vertebral and back-breaking imagery. The focus expression is therefore pre-impact: cognition of an imminent bodily break produces the grimace and possible freeze before the event lands.

activation_trace.role: The visible front registers anticipation before the threatened action reaches the body.
Anxiety, thought, and dread give the face its anticipatory affect.
Stillness adds a freeze response to the anticipatory grimace.
Certainty arising from an indication makes the expected event cognitively present before impact.
An outcome that cannot be trusted preserves uncertainty as an alternative source of dread.
The production of an act supplies an impending external event rather than an already completed state.
Articulated vertebrae give the threatened calamity a concrete spinal axis.
A back-breaking disaster supplies the magnitude and bodily consequence expected by the face.

structural_cues: 75:25 immediately continues the feminine face class with تَظُنُّ and the pronoun بِهَا.
The passive أَن يُفْعَلَ keeps the acting source unstated while making the anticipated action central.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expectation, an action to be done, vertebrae, and a back-breaking disaster; I infer that anticipation causes the present facial freeze before impact. Alternatively, the predicate may simply name the class's settled fate, and ظن may remain uncertain rather than near-certain.

changed_reading.before: The face reacts to a punishment already present.
changed_reading.after: The face is caught in the interval before impact, already contorted and immobilized by its reading of an imminent back-breaking event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The face inventory permits social eminence, while the later sequence depicts denial, turning away, and an extended swaggering posture before one's kin-group. The focus can therefore stage a loss of face: a cultivated social front and rank collapse into publicly visible displeasure.

activation_trace.role: Social rank and leading persons allow the plural faces to carry public standing as well as anatomy.
The conspicuous grimace reverses the composure expected of an eminent social front.
Falsehood supplies the conduct concealed by the prior social presentation.
Turning away supplies the bodily-social refusal preceding the display at home.
The circle of kin and belonging provides the audience before whom status is performed.
Swagger through extended posture supplies the earlier performance of confidence and rank.

structural_cues: 75:31-33 moves from failed affirmation and worship to denial, bodily turning, and a return to family in display posture.
The public plural وُجُوهٌ can sustain a social reading without ceasing to denote literal faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a status branch for face and a sequence of denial, turning, kin audience, and swagger; I infer a reversal from performed eminence to exposed loss of face. Alternatively, وُجُوهٌ may refer to all persons without singling out notables or social presentation.

changed_reading.before: The plural denotes anonymous frightened faces.
changed_reading.after: It can also expose collapsed social fronts: those who carried themselves before their own people with visible confidence now bear public humiliation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the hands-first birth branch is highly specialized and the noun in 75:24 does not itself denote birth. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains a visible mechanism from fingertips, semen, attached pregnancy, resurrection, and renewed life. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain 'as if' image of re-emergence, never as the lexical meaning of وُجُوهٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines the hands-first birth branch of و ج ه with the premature or before-time branch of ب س ر.

activation_trace.role: The specialized hands-first presentation supplies the anomalous birth topology.
Prematurity and action before due time make the imagined emergence difficult and mistimed.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour supply the second-emergence setting.
Reconstituted extremities make the hands-first image materially visible.
Generative fluid from which form is apportioned supplies the first-birth side of the analogy.
Pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies the attached developmental stage.
Living animation supplies the endpoint common to first creation and re-creation.

changed_reading.before: The faces simply appear after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory image level, they emerge as if through a difficult second birth: reconstructed to the fingertips yet raw and unready for the arrival.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it joins the predicate's first-sunrise and unripe-fruit scope to specialized moon and day-front images, not to the ordinary contextual senses of sun and moon. It remains anchored by both focus roots and by the packet's disrupted luminaries. Render only as a material-cosmic resonance, not as a claim that the face literally is dawn or fruit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branches allow و ج ه as the forepart of a day and ب س ر as unripe matter or the sun at first rising.

activation_trace.role: The beginning or forepart, especially of a day, turns the face into a temporal front.
Unripe fruit and first sunrise supply a raw early-light surface.
Gathering dispersed parts supplies the operation later applied to the luminaries.
Flash and glare supply the unstable light preceding the cosmic collapse.
Fruit struck before ripening mirrors the focus predicate's unripe material image through a lunar root.
The sun and its brightness supply the light-source whose ordinary cycle is disrupted.

changed_reading.before: The grimace belongs only to human affect.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the face also carries the raw surface of a day whose light has failed to mature normally as moon and sun lose their ordinary separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The plural grammar most naturally denotes multiple persons, so reading one subject's multiple social fronts is deliberately non-primary. It remains anchored in the focus root's double-facedness branch and gains a coherent exposure mechanism from self-sight, curtain-like excuses, false appearance, and turning away. Downstream prose should mark it as a possible social-ethical echo, not a grammatical resolution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وُجُوهٌ activates the two-facedness branch of و ج ه, while بَاسِرَةٌ supplies the involuntary expression that can no longer maintain those fronts.

activation_trace.role: Literal two-sidedness and figurative double-faced conduct supply plural social fronts within one subject.
The involuntary grimace marks the collapse of controlled presentation.
The self itself provides the stable identity beneath competing fronts.
Curtains supply attempted coverings for the subject's discrepant fronts.
A garment that deceives by its appearance supplies the model of a misleading social exterior.
Turning away supplies the behavioral pivot by which one front avoids confrontation.

changed_reading.before: The plural faces are only distinct members of a crowd.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, they can also suggest the failure of multiple cultivated fronts when self-witness removes the coverings and one uncontrolled face remains.

strongest_changes: The face became the identifying front of a precisely reconstituted person rather than a generic crowd-mask.
The paired face clauses and Lordward gaze made the focus relational and directional, with contraction opposed to luminous active facing.
The next ayah moved the grimace into a pre-impact interval: the face freezes while anticipating a back-breaking act.
Self-insight and curtain-like excuses made the facial state involuntary testimony that cannot be covered.
The haste/immediate/later sequence activated a materially unripe face as the outcome of disordered timing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted a short facial predicate into mechanisms of embodiment, directional agency, temporal ripeness, self-disclosure, and status reversal without requiring those readings to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The stillness, compulsion, and prematurity branches of ب س ر may be resonant secondary images rather than active senses in the focus form.
The Lordward gaze of the radiant class does not by itself prove that the contrasting class is visually arrested.
The social-rank reading of وُجُوهٌ is possible from the inventory but less secure than literal faces or persons.
The birth, cosmic-ripeness, and double-face outliers depend on explicitly cross-domain branch transfer and must remain qualified.
